description: Land Aquisition Madawalamulla South, Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District - Sec. 05
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain lands are required for a public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed land descriptions, boundaries, extents, and cadastral information, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
